note: QR ATTENDANCE (owner, 9 Nov 2026) — SmartEPT's QR Attendance (QRONEX) concept without Gate-to-PC. These are the shipped defaults and the allowed ranges; each company's own values are saved on Time & Attendance → QR Attendance as a versioned customisation (key qr-attendance). A gate screen shows a code that changes every few seconds; the employee scans it in the SmartPRS3 mobile app; the server checks the code, its age, the gate, the employee's branch, GPS accuracy and distance before the punch is recorded.
